title: Railgun canary scheduler for private control plane upgrades
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a deterministic, auditable canary scheduler (Railgun) for private (VPC) control-plane upgrades. The goal is to automate phased upgrades across customer control planes using Terraform/IaC modules, implement traffic-shadowing and health-check gating, and provide rollback/fallback automation tied into Console observability. This ticket covers the scheduler service, IaC module changes, health checks, and runbook updates for the canary path.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module 'control_plane_canary' can create/update canary cohorts via a single apply
Scheduler launches canary cohort upgrades with traffic-shadowing enabled (no user traffic change) and completes health-validation gating within configured thresholds
Automatic rollback/failover triggers when health checks breach thresholds; rollback verified in staging and two pilot customers
Dashboard displays per-cohort rollout status, success/failure metrics, and per-control-plane version map
Runbook and automated incident alerts in PagerDuty are in place; security review completed and KMS integration validated
implementation_steps: Design lightweight scheduler service 'railgun-scheduler' that reads desired control-plane version change and target cohort list from Terraform state or a secured config bucket
Extend Terraform IaC with module 'modules/control_plane_canary' exposing variables: target_version, cohort_size_pct, health_gate_rules, shadowing=true, max_parallel=integer
Add state locking via existing DynamoDB/consul backend to prevent concurrent schedules for same customer
Implement canary orchestration logic: create canary cohort resources, apply control-plane version to selected CP instances, enable traffic-shadowing for 48h by default
Wire health checks pipeline: gather metrics (latency, error rate, reconciliation lag) and KV cache hit rates; evaluate against configured gating rules
Implement automatic rollback workflow via terraform rollback plan and scheduler-triggered apply; publish change events to event bus for audit
Add feature flags and rollout options: dry-run, manual-approve, emergency-override, and abort-on-critical
Add integration tests and e2e staging run against private-deploy testbed; document test harness and seed customers for pilot
health_checks_and_slo: Primary metrics: control-plane API p95 latency < 120ms, 5xx error rate < 0.1% over 10m window
Health gate evaluation window: rolling 15m windows sampled for 3 consecutive windows before promote
Failure conditions: any critical alert (control-plane down) OR sustained breach of primary metrics for 3 consecutive windows
Canary duration: default 48 hours, configurable per-release via Terraform variable
terraform_changes: New module: modules/control_plane_canary with inputs: target_version, cohort_selector_expression, cohort_size_pct, health_gate_rules, enable_shadowing
State artifact: canary_schedule_{customer}-{release} stored in S3 with KMS encryption
Outputs: canary_id, cohort_instances, scheduled_by, scheduled_at, status_endpoint

Example usage in customer overlay: module "control_plane_canary" { source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//control_plane_canary" target_version = "v1.22.3" cohort_size_pct = 5 }
Add acceptance tests in terratest to validate module idempotency and rollback path
rollout_strategy: Phase 0 (dry-run): simulate plan and publish expected changes to Console without applying
Phase 1 (shadowing): apply upgrade to 5% cohort with traffic-shadowing enabled; collect health signals for 48h
Phase 2 (staged ramp): if Phase 1 passes, ramp to 25% then 50% with gating windows; each ramp requires health gate pass
Phase 3 (full): remaining 50-100% applied with parallelism capped by max_parallel variable
Fallback: immediate rollback if critical health gates fail; fallback path must complete within SLO for rollback time
monitoring_alerts: Create alert 'CP-Canary-Primary-Breach' firing on p95 latency or 5xx breaches during canary; pager routing to oncall and release owner
Console dashboard: per-canary timeline view, per-cohort metrics, and rollback triggers
Audit events: all canary state transitions emitted to audit-log topic with retention 1 year
Synthetic checks: pre-upgrade and post-upgrade synthetics validating common admin endpoints
test_plan: Unit tests for scheduler state machine and gating logic
Integration tests: end-to-end canary in staging cluster with controlled failure injection
Chaos test: inject KV cache degradation during staging canary and validate rollback
Pilot: run canary on two consenting pilot customers in private environment during off-peak window
Post-release: 2-week monitoring and MTTD/MTR review, collect customer feedback
